svg.aria-label: Masroof — Android · Side Project. Your bank texts you, Masroof does the bookkeeping. It turns Egyptian bank SMS into a categorised, offline budget — subscriptions, installments, savings circles and encrypted backups. Zero network calls. Stack: Expo, React Native, Kotlin, SQLite, Drizzle, Zod.
